description.value: ZUBU is a Japanese ramen restaurant with four Lower Mainland locations, with this downtown Vancouver outpost opening in January 2023. The menu, helmed by Executive Chef William Cao (a graduate of Kitchen Hyodo Ramen School in Oyama, Japan), centres on ramen made with locally sourced and Japanese-imported ingredients, alongside temaki, hand-made gyoza, and rice bowls. A full cocktail program rounds out the experience.
